sloka: ते हयैः गो रथैः शीघ्रैः स्यन्दनैः च मनो जवैः ।सह योधैः बल अध्यक्षा बलम् सर्वम् अचोदयन् ॥२-८२-२६॥
transliteration: te hayaiḥ go rathaiḥ śīghraiḥ syandanaiḥ ca mano javaiḥ ।saha yodhaiḥ bala adhyakṣā balam sarvam acodayan ॥2-82-26॥

translations.english: Those chiefs of the army urged the soldiers, horses, fastmoving bullockcarts and swift chariots (to move on).
